description: This file defines the UtilHttp class, which provides a comprehensive set of HTTP utility functions for a web application framework, including request parameter handling, session and attribute management, content streaming, security headers, URL encoding, and other web-related helpers.

classes.name: UtilHttp
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for HTTP request/response handling, including parameter parsing, security headers, content streaming, session management, URL encoding, and request attribute management for a web framework.

methods.name: getCombinedMap
methods.description: Creates a combined map merging request parameters, servlet context attributes, session attributes, and request attributes, with override precedence.

methods.name: getParameterMap
methods.description: Constructs a canonicalized map of request parameters, including handling of multi-part uploads and URI path parameters.

methods.name: getServletFileUpload
methods.description: Creates a JakartaServletFileUpload instance configured with size limits and temp directory based on delegator properties.

methods.name: getMultiPartParameterMap
methods.description: Parses multipart form data, extracting form fields and file uploads into a map, and registering upload progress listener.

methods.name: getMaxUploadSize
methods.description: Returns maximum upload size configured in general properties or default.

methods.name: getSizeThreshold
methods.description: Returns size threshold for file upload buffering based on general properties or default.

methods.name: getTmpUploadRepository
methods.description: Returns temporary directory for uploads based on delegator configuration.

methods.name: getQueryStringOnlyParameterMap
methods.description: Parses URL query string into a parameter map.

methods.name: getPathInfoOnlyParameterMap
methods.description: Extracts parameters encoded in the URI path segments.

methods.name: getUrlOnlyParameterMap
methods.description: Combines URL query string and URI path parameters into a map.

methods.name: canonicalizeParameterMap
methods.description: Sanitizes and standardizes request parameter values.

methods.name: canonicalizeParameter
methods.description: Canonicalizes individual parameter string, mainly for URL/security encoding.

methods.name: getJSONAttributeMap
methods.description: Converts request attributes into a map suitable for JSON responses, with nested parsing.

methods.name: parseJSONAttributeMap
methods.description: Recursively processes a map to prepare for JSON serialization.

methods.name: parseJSONAttributeValue
methods.description: Processes individual attribute values for JSON serialization, converting timestamps and nested structures.

methods.name: getAttributeMap
methods.description: Returns a map of all request attributes, optionally skipping specified names.

methods.name: getSessionMap
methods.description: Returns a map of session attributes, optionally skipping specified names.

methods.name: getServletContextMap
methods.description: Returns a map of servlet context attributes, optionally skipping specified names.

methods.name: makeParamMapWithPrefix
methods.description: Creates a map of request parameters with keys starting with a specific prefix, including optional suffix filtering.

methods.name: makeParamListWithSuffix
methods.description: Creates a list of parameter values from request and additional fields matching specified prefix and suffix.

methods.name: getApplicationName
methods.description: Derives the application name from request context path, replacing slashes with underscores.

methods.name: setInitialRequestInfo
methods.description: Initializes session attributes with request details such as URL, locale, headers, etc.

methods.name: getServerRootUrl
methods.description: Constructs base URL for server using request scheme, host and port.

methods.name: getFullRequestUrl
methods.description: Builds the full URL including scheme, host, port, path and query string.

methods.name: getRequestMethod
methods.description: Determines the HTTP method, allowing override via '_method' parameter.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Retrieves current Locale considering session, user login, and request headers, with fallback to default.

methods.name: setLocale
methods.description: Sets locale attribute in session.

methods.name: setLocaleIfNone
methods.description: Sets locale in session if none exists, based on input string.

methods.name: setTimeZone
methods.description: Sets TimeZone in session.

methods.name: setTimeZoneIfNone
methods.description: Sets TimeZone in session if none exists, based on input string.

methods.name: getTimeZone
methods.description: Retrieves TimeZone from session, with fallback to user login or default. Also accepts app default.

methods.name: getVisualTheme
methods.description: Returns the current VisualTheme object from session.

methods.name: setVisualTheme
methods.description: Sets VisualTheme in session.

methods.name: getCurrencyUom
methods.description: Retrieves the ISO currency code from session or user login, with default fallback.

methods.name: setCurrencyUom
methods.description: Sets currency UOM in session.

methods.name: setCurrencyUomIfNone
methods.description: Sets currency UOM if none exists in session.

methods.name: urlEncodeArgs
methods.description: Encodes a map of URL arguments with options for expanded entities and preservation of empty values.

methods.name: getEncodedParameter
methods.description: URL-encodes a single parameter value.

methods.name: getRequestUriFromTarget
methods.description: Extracts the request URI from a target string.

methods.name: getQueryStringFromTarget
methods.description: Extracts the query string part from a URL target.

methods.name: removeQueryStringFromTarget
methods.description: Removes the query string from a URL target.

methods.name: getWebappMountPointFromTarget
methods.description: Retrieves the web app mount point from a URL target.

methods.name: encodeAmpersands
methods.description: Escapes ampersands in HTML strings to &.

methods.name: encodeBlanks
methods.description: Replaces spaces with %20 in a string.

methods.name: setResponseBrowserProxyNoCache
methods.description: Sets HTTP headers to prevent browser caching responses.

methods.name: setResponseBrowserDefaultSecurityHeaders
methods.description: Sets default security-related HTTP headers, including Content Security Policy, security headers for XSS and MIME sniffing, and security policies.

methods.name: getContentTypeByFileName
methods.description: Returns MIME type based on filename extension.

methods.name: streamContentToBrowser
methods.description: Streams byte array content to browser with appropriate headers.

methods.name: streamContentToBrowser
methods.description: Streams byte array content with specified content type.

methods.name: streamContentToBrowser
methods.description: Streams InputStream content with specified length and headers.

methods.name: streamContent
methods.description: Helper to transfer data from InputStream to OutputStream, buffered with size from configuration.

methods.name: stripViewParamsFromQueryString
methods.description: Removes pagination and view index parameters from a query string.

methods.name: stripNamedParamsFromQueryString
methods.description: Removes specified parameter names from a query string.
